geometryNote: Simplified from LINZ Topo50 lake polygons (about 0.0015 degree tolerance) and LINZ river-name pilot polygons (about 0.00018 degree tolerance). No connecting channels were invented. Nondegenerate polygon holes were retained. River-name geometry is an approximate named extent, not a continuous hydrographic network.
